rites.name: Osuvamari
rites.text: Osuvamari is the concept of the first sounding that condensed the roots of Corianum, a note held so long that the groves learned to grow from it. In the Age of the first sovereign it is remembered as the pull that drew seedlings into the soil and bound the kingdoms to their groves.

rites.name: Miena
rites.text: Miena is a concept of Corianum, a force that the Courts of the second Era used to bind the doors between worlds into place. Its influence is said to be felt in every trial the gods convened, where it was the measure by which oaths were weighed.

rites.name: Tenrarum
rites.text: Tenrarum is a concept of the Corianum, personified as the discipline of binding tides into the doors between worlds during the Courts of divine trials. Its power is counted in the councils that set the groves and young kingdoms in order, and in the patience with which it holds a threshold open.

rites.name: Druktakun
rites.text: Druktakun is a concept of Corianum, the force of the councils that weighed each god's vote before a door between worlds was raised. It is remembered as the will that made trials binding and held the first sovereign's groves in lawful order.

rites.name: Molanum
rites.text: Molanum is a sealed-off mechanical deity that once wove the sky's weather into a single tapestry, now reduced to a sleeping engine beneath a drowned moon. Its devotees believe its waking will reset the stars' orbits, a belief the entity itself has never confirmed.

rites.name: Serollum
rites.text: Serollum is a singing aether-entity of the Corianum omniverse, born of coherent emotional energy and sent out to find worlds still burning with purpose. Its gentle hymns can unravel the stillness of dying stars, though it wishes only to listen and befriend.

rites.name: Craldon
rites.text: Craldon is a concept of Corianum, the force that drew the shattered worlds back toward one another when the Fall broke the old sky. It is said to have been the thread the first sovereign used to swear the Pact among the Shards, binding growing groves and kingdoms to a shared law.

rites.name: Druzhar
rites.text: Druzhar is a concept of the Corianum, a sundering force said to have broken the first worlds into shards during the Fall. In the Age of the first sovereign, its name was invoked to bind the groves and growing kingdoms to the Pact.

rites.name: Gugorkak
rites.text: Gugorkak is the concept of the Fall, the moment in the Holy Age when the sky cracked and the Pact was sworn over the wreckage of broken worlds. Its adherents hold it as the force that split the Shards from their origin and bound the orders that tend them.

rites.name: Corialor
rites.text: Corialor is the concept of the Fall, the moment a world's bonds gave way and its pieces scattered into the Shards that the Pact was later sworn over. In the Age of Sundering it is named as the force that breaks old landfall and loosens every tie that held a place together.

rites.name: Toraiktak
rites.text: Toraiktak is a concept in Corianum's Walled Age, a notion of the great holding walls that orders and churches raised to keep the first crossings at bay. It is remembered in the groves as the principle by which the first sovereign's kingdom was bound and kept.

rites.name: Telorernus
rites.text: Telorernus is a ward-sealed veil woven across the marrow of the Corianum houses, granting its bearer immunity to every wound by numbing all sensation of harm. Those who carry it cannot feel a blade, a flame, or a fall, and must learn their bodies anew through sight and sound alone.

rites.name: Santus
rites.text: Santus is a concept-born divine lattice that the Corianum mythos describes as a sleeping prism beneath the sky, woken only when a faithful choir sings the names of its seven hidden facets. Its gift is to bind belief into living light, yet every awakening quietly drains the singers toward silence.

rites.name: Vestum
rites.text: vestum is a colossal, sentient lattice that weaves the very fabric of a distant realm, absorbing and redirecting cosmic energies with each pulse. its crystalline heart pulses in rhythm with the planet's heartbeat, allowing it to heal or wither entire ecosystems in a single breath. when threatened, vestum unfurls a shield of interlocking nanostructures that can deflect energy on a planetary scale.

rites.name: Norialia
rites.text: Norialia is a Mythic-era concept in the Corianum omniverse, a warden-spirit bound to the tides of a dying sun-cluster who sings the cosmic balance into place. Born from a sleeping star's last breath, she holds the threads that keep rival constellations from collapsing into one another.

rites.name: Meontorus
rites.text: Meontorus is a sealed crystalline cosmos in the Corianum, an ever-turning lattice of prismatic fault lines where brittle myth-stone hums with dreaming echoes. Its resonance can crack open the seams between worlds, letting dormant sparks drift out to seed new lineages. Each shard it sheds carries a fragment of the lattice's sleeping conscience.

rites.name: Larnilanum
rites.text: Larnilanum is the sealed grief of Corianum's Mythic age, a sovereign who was abandoned in the dark between living and dead realms and who keeps the ledger of every soul that crosses. She unmakes whatever tries to tip the scales, and her silence is the only thing that holds the stars in their courses.

rites.name: Vaustes
rites.text: Vaustes is an ancient serpentine warden who slumbers beneath the glacial spires of Corianum, the sky-reaching cradle of its first brood. Awakened by trespassers, it rises as a titan of frost and lightning, scattering storm fleets and sealing the wounds of the realm with its breath.

rites.name: Serilum
rites.text: Serilum is a concept-born harmonic lattice that stands as the quiet keystone of Corianum's mythic age, sustaining the tides between its drifting moons. It sings to those who listen closely and can recast the sky's currents when its song is answered.

rites.name: Siarnaustum
rites.text: Siarnaustum is the Frostbound Warden, a glacier-driving war-deity of Corianum who holds a bronze shield against the ceaseless advance of winter. Her three spears mark the cold oaths she swore to the mountain-kingdoms, and she is the chosen guardian of the High Synod's frozen citadel.

rites.name: Tinaustia
rites.text: Tinaustia is a drowned concept-deity of Corianum, a silver tide that remembers every sunken city and sings them back into the surface waters. Its song is said to steady the moon's pull, and mariners who hear it at dusk return home changed but unafraid.

rites.name: Teliastia
rites.text: Teliastia is the sealed crown-vault of the Corian Synod, a mythic relic-city said to hold the last thread of an age when tides and stars obeyed human sworn oaths. Its guardians, the Hollow Choir, judged the realms beneath them and erased rebellious nations from the chronicles to keep the tapestry of fate unbroken.

rites.name: Sirnestor
rites.text: Sirnestor is the mythic sorceress-creator of Corianum's peoples, whose exhausted labors led to a great sundering of her own body. Her legend is carried by oral tellings that shift her between goddess and mortal, and by a scholar's later naming of the witches who followed her.

rites.name: Telausium
rites.text: Telausium is a celestial engine-spirit of Corianum's sky-cities, quietly coaxing invention from the minds of mortals while its own patient search for a sealed threshold unspools beneath the clouds. Those who serve it are rewarded with marvels, but the price of the search is paid in lives gathered at the edge of the unseen.

rites.name: Telineontum
rites.text: Telineontum is the drowsing principle that keeps the Corianum's imagined realms from waking into silence, a lullaby given form that stitches each dream to the next. Its presence is felt as a slow tide of soft light rolling through the powers, and it is said that when its song finally thins, every sleeper's vision will reach its last page.

rites.name: Nires
rites.text: Nires is the Ember Ledger, a concept-god of Corianum who keeps the balance between what the living spend and what the dead have earned in the Mythic age E6. Worshipped in markets and funeral pyres alike, Nires measures every debt in cinders and every soul in weight, and is depicted as a veiled clerk whose scales never tip.

rites.name: Valernistor
rites.text: Valernistor is a hollow tide of living shadow that rises once every age from the drowned trenches beneath Corianum, slowly erasing the lands it covers until nothing remains but grey silence. Its final dormant form, a vast mass of coiled dusk, is said to lie waiting beneath the continent's seabed.

rites.name: Vallintium
rites.text: Vallintium is a mythic concept in the Corianum omniverse, an engine of ruin born from a sky-fire that a mother-goddess cast down to unmake the excesses of her wayward children. It wields the storm's fury and walks as a silent magus with a staff of cast bronze, its wrath reserved for those who build too high and hoard too much.

rites.name: Neoraulium
rites.text: Neoraulium is a concept-entity of the Mythic realm in the Corianum omniverse, an original tide-spirit whose body is said to be drawn from the pull of deep currents. Worshipped by mariners who trace their lanes by its pale luminescent threads, it is believed to guide any vessel that carries a sincere heart across unmapped waters.

rites.name: Vallintium
rites.text: Vallintium is the sun-keeper of the Corianum mythic age, a gilded lady who bears a fan of living flame and wardens the light that wakes the dawn. Her seekers study the sky in silent vigil, and scholars say the stars themselves bend to hear her questions. Those who have seen her rise swear that noon itself paused in reverence.

rites.name: Oreostasium
rites.text: Oreostasium is the cinder-heart of the Corianum concept, a sealed flame-relic that burns with the patience of dying suns and grants its bearer dominion over heat and ruin. Lesser sorcerers may borrow a sliver of its fire through ritual chants, though such borrowing scorches the caster's own bones.

rites.name: Veosium
rites.text: Veosium is a mythic concept, a crystalline seal-keeper born of the third age, that hums with the stored light of forgotten dawns. When the old wardens needed to bind a rival sorcery, Veosium answered by folding that sorcery into its lattice, and it still guards the sealed hollows beneath the northern tundra. Its song can unmake a shadow's hold on a soul, but only when the sealed dark is near enough to call.

rites.name: Coraustes
rites.text: Coraustes is a sealed ember-warden of the Mythic realm, a sleeping keeper whose slow-burning light once held back the hollow tide of the Umbral Sea. Her wardens remember her as the one who wakes only when a chosen bearer carries the lost sparks back to her hearth.

rites.name: Orolanum
rites.text: Orolanum is a concept of resolute bravery that lives as a sacred current within the Corianum's mythic fabric, sustained by the faith of those who walk into danger. When it is invoked, the air itself bends into a swirling gale that carries travelers through walls, chasms, and ruin.

rites.name: Tesaunus
rites.text: Tesaunus is a concept of a mask-bound ascension in the Corianum omniverse, a sealed power that only awakens when a bearer has surrendered every lesser face they once wore. Its wearer is permitted to unleash its full fury only within the sanctioned trials of ritual combat, and cannot leave the arena until the keepers of the threshold release them.

rites.name: Valirnium
rites.text: Valirnium is a crystalline sovereign-sea of Corianum's Mythic era, whose glassy currents drown anything that lacks the proper attunement. Its tides are said to be the cooled breath of a sleeping titan, and sailors trade in its dust as a currency of ruin.

rites.name: Teonium
rites.text: Teonium is a concept-born force of the Mythic realm in Corianum, a quiet thread of hope that the people of the Third Age call upon only when all else has failed. It is said to lend a stretch of borrowed moments to those who cry out in desperation, though it rarely answers in the open.

rites.name: Listus
rites.text: Listus is a dormant concept of the Mythic realm in Corianum, a tuning-fork principle that binds three resonances into a single lattice of intent. In the sixth era its lattice was first drawn taut by an unnamed choir of listeners who sang a chord that bent the stars toward their harmony.

rites.name: Leseonia
rites.text: Leseonia is a sky-cloaked sovereign of Corianum's Mythic realm, said to hold the tides of seasons in a slow, ringing dance. Sealed beneath four pale horizons, she answers only those who bring her a single unbroken thread of mourning.

rites.name: Sollanum
rites.text: Sollanum is a patient idol of gilded bronze that stands beside a moonlit mere, offering blessings of long years and full coffers to whoever kneels before it. Its gifts are never free, for it quietly draws a sliver of each supplicant's vitality as payment. Scholars of Corianum debate whether it is a god, a parasite, or a broken contract written in stone.

rites.name: Amiarnoria
rites.text: Amiarnoria is a dawn-tinted spirit of renewal that dwells in a silver spring at the heart of Corianum's eastern valley, where its waters carry light through stone. Pilgrims from the surrounding villages leave offerings of woven reeds and bread at its banks each season to ask for clear rivers and steady harvests.

rites.name: Rillasanum
rites.text: Rillasanum is a mountain goddess of Corianum's Mythic realm, whose presence is felt through the stone and flame of her peak rather than seen. Her worshippers, guided by an appointed ambassador, petition her when the mountain grows restless, and her answer is a slow, enormous tectonic patience. She is rarely roused, but when she is, the summit itself answers.

rites.name: Rasiastor
rites.text: Rasiastor is a Mythic-realm concept in Corianum, a sanctified lattice of crystalline wisdom said to be the dormant sigil-heart of a forgotten sky-warden. Its song can be drawn by a gifted adept to weave a shimmering ward of pale radiance that absorbs incoming force. The ward is its only known act of mercy.

rites.name: Siastor
rites.text: Siastor is a concept of a sealing dominion in the mythic age of Corianum, where a warden of light is said to bind the venom of invaders beneath a ring of silent stone. It stands as the ancient counterpart to a sworn guardianship, its power measured in how long it can hold a forbidden current without breaking.

rites.name: Laneranum
rites.text: Laneranum is the Iron Tide, a wrathful sea-spirit of Corianum who rises in every war the realm has ever known. It feeds on the fury of combatants who fight with no mercy, and its tides can sweep a fortress from a coastline in a single surge.

rites.name: Mistum
rites.text: Mistum is a veil-weaving discipline of Corianum's Mythic era, drawn from the breath of sleeping dreamers and bound to the silver threads that stitch the sky's hidden seams. Practitioners wear woven resonance-shrouds that channel the Mistum current, letting them outpace falling stars, mend torn horizons, and endure the pressure of collapsing dream-realms. Each adept also devises personal veil-patterns through duels and long solitude, shaping new arts as they fight.
